selection: Clean DOIs had no Crossref retraction/withdrawal/removal/EoC on the work itself and no flagged ancestor within default depth 2 on an isolated graph as of 15 Oct 2026. They are not a random sample. Cleveland Clinic is not fetched.

gate.rule: Seeded regression, not accuracy. caught = warn or block on a positive fixture (block required for the retraction case). alarm = warn/review/block on a clean fixture at the same default depth.

positives.name: Allen 2013
positives.cypher:
MATCH (a:Answer {id: $answer_id})-[:CITES]->(s:Source)
MATCH p0 = (s)-[:RESTS_ON*1..2]->(w)
MATCH (n:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(w:Work)
WITH DISTINCT s, w, n
CALL algo.SPpaths({sourceNode: s, targetNode: w, relTypes: ['RESTS_ON'], relDirection: 'outgoing', maxLen: 2, weightProp: 'cost'})
YIELD path, pathCost
WITH s, w, n, path, pathCost, relationships(path) AS rels
RETURN s.url AS source_url,
       s.title AS source_title,
       w.doi AS root_doi,
       w.title AS root_title,
       w.year AS root_year,
       n.doi AS notice_doi,
       n.type AS notice_type,
       n.label AS notice_label,
       n.date AS notice_date,
       n.source AS notice_source,
       length(path) AS hops,
       reduce(score = 0.0, r IN rels | score + coalesce(r.cost, 20.0)) AS sp_cost,
       reduce(score = 1.0, r IN rels | score * coalesce(r.weight, 0.0)) AS path_score,
       [x IN nodes(path) | {doi: x.doi, title: x.title, url: x.url, year: x.year}] AS steps,
       [r IN rels | {weight: r.weight, reliance: r.reliance, sentence: r.sentence, evidence_from: r.evidence_from, judged: r.judged, cost: r.cost}] AS hops_evidence
ORDER BY sp_cost ASC, hops ASC
LIMIT 40
positives.wcc_call:
CALL algo.WCC({nodeLabels: ['Work'], relationshipTypes: ['RESTS_ON']})
YIELD node, componentId
WITH node, componentId
OPTIONAL MATCH (flag:Notice)-[:FLAGS]->(node)
WITH componentId,
     collect(DISTINCT node.doi) AS work_dois,
     [d IN collect(DISTINCT flag.doi) WHERE d IS NOT NULL] AS notice_dois,
     [t IN collect(DISTINCT flag.type) WHERE t IS NOT NULL] AS notice_types
WHERE size(notice_dois) > 0
MATCH (a:Answer)-[:CITES]->(:Source)-[:RESTS_ON]->(w:Work)
WHERE w.doi IN work_dois
RETURN componentId,
       work_dois,
       notice_dois,
       notice_types,
       collect(DISTINCT a.id) AS answer_ids,
       collect(DISTINCT a.engine) AS engines
